steps.title: Select pipette, mount, and tip rack
steps.instruction: Choose the desired pipette and its mount (left or right) and select the tip rack you will use for this demonstration.

steps.title: Load tip rack on deck
steps.instruction: Place the selected tip rack in deck slot 1 of the OT‑2 robot.

steps.title: Pick up pipette tip
steps.instruction: Command the robot to pick up a tip from the loaded tip rack.

steps.title: Drop pipette tip
steps.instruction: Command the robot to drop the tip.

steps.title: Play sound
steps.instruction: After the tip is dropped, a song will play through the OT‑2 speaker.
